summary: Glacier National Park is a stunning alpine wilderness featuring over 700 miles of pristine trails, turquoise glacial lakes, and dramatic jagged peaks across the Montana landscape. With abundant wildlife, world-class hiking, and unparalleled photography opportunities, this UNESCO World Heritage Site offers the ultimate adventure for outdoor enthusiasts. The park's accessible infrastructure and diverse lodging options make it perfect for both rugged backpackers and comfort-seeking travelers.

restaurants.name: Serrano's Saloon & Cantina
restaurants.description: A West Glacier institution serving authentic Mexican cuisine and regional specialties in a lively atmosphere. Known for margaritas and hearty portions perfect after a day of hiking.

restaurants.name: Eddie's Cafe
restaurants.description: Casual diner offering breakfast, sandwiches, and classic American fare with quick service. Perfect for grabbing fuel before hitting the trails.

restaurants.name: Whitefish Lake Restaurant
restaurants.description: Upscale lakefront dining featuring Montana-sourced ingredients and farm-to-table preparations with panoramic views. An excellent choice for celebratory dinners.

restaurants.name: MacKenzie River Pizza Co.
restaurants.description: Locally-owned pizza joint in Whitefish using Montana beef and fresh ingredients for creative wood-fired pizzas. A favorite with locals and visitors alike.

restaurants.name: The Depot Market Restaurant
restaurants.description: Historic restored train depot converted into a charming restaurant serving burgers, salads, and pasta in an authentic railroad setting. Great for families.

restaurants.name: Many Glacier Hotel Dining Room
restaurants.description: Historic 1915 hotel restaurant with views of Swiftcurrent Lake and Mount Jackson, offering regional comfort food and fine dining experiences. Perfect for special occasions.

restaurants.name: Walton's Authentic Mexican Restaurant
restaurants.description: Family-run restaurant in Kalispell serving homemade authentic Mexican cuisine with fresh ingredients and generous portions. A local favorite for generations.

restaurants.name: Montana Coffee Traders
restaurants.description: Cozy cafe in Whitefish featuring locally-roasted coffee, fresh pastries, and light breakfast/lunch options. Ideal for a quick morning stop.

restaurants.name: Cafe Crema
restaurants.description: Italian-inspired cafe in Whitefish offering wood-fired pizza, pasta, and espresso in a romantic setting. Known for fresh ingredients and traditional preparations.

restaurants.name: Great Northern Brewing Company
restaurants.description: Craft brewery and taproom in Whitefish with house-made beers, pub food, and outdoor seating with mountain views. Great for relaxing evenings.
restaurants.mustTry: Local IPA and fish and chips

restaurants.name: The Back Room Tavern
restaurants.description: Casual tavern in West Glacier serving hearty portions of classic American comfort food and local beers in a friendly atmosphere. Perfect for post-hike meals.

restaurants.name: Russell's Fireside Dining
restaurants.description: Upscale casual restaurant featuring game meats, steaks, and fresh seafood in an elegant log cabin setting with fireplace. Ideal for romantic dinners.

activities.name: Grinnell Glacier Trail Hike
activities.description: A stunning 10.6-mile round-trip hike from Many Glacier Hotel to pristine turquoise Grinnell Lake and the glacier itself. Features incredible alpine scenery and potential wildlife viewing including mountain goats and bears.

activities.name: Going-to-the-Sun Road Scenic Drive
activities.description: Iconic 50-mile highway crossing the Continental Divide with breathtaking mountain vistas, turquoise lakes, and pullout opportunities. The road traverses from West Glacier to St. Mary, gaining over 3,400 feet in elevation.

activities.name: Lake McDonald Boat Tour
activities.description: Guided scenic boat tour on the park's largest lake with interpretive commentary about geology, wildlife, and history. Offers relaxing water-based sightseeing with mountain backdrop.

activities.name: Backcountry Camping & Backpacking
activities.description: Experience true wilderness with overnight backcountry campsites accessible via park trails. Requires permit and preparation but offers solitude and immersion in pristine alpine environments.

activities.name: Avalanche Lake Trail
activities.description: A moderate 3.5-mile hike from the Avalanche Picnic Area through old-growth cedar forest to a stunning glacial lake surrounded by waterfalls. One of the most photographed locations in the park.

activities.name: Guided Wildlife Tour
activities.description: Professional guide leads early morning or evening tours to find bears, mountain goats, bighorn sheep, and eagles. Includes binoculars and expert knowledge of animal behavior.

activities.name: St. Mary Lake Sunrise Paddle
activities.description: Canoe or kayak experience launching at dawn to catch spectacular sunrise light over the park's second-largest lake. Peaceful water-based adventure with stunning photography opportunities.

activities.name: Two Medicine Lake Loop Trail
activities.description: Scenic 3.3-mile trail along pristine Two Medicine Lake with views of Mount Jackson and Eagle Plume Falls. Excellent for photography with opportunities to see wildlife.

activities.name: Ranger-Led Naturalist Program
activities.description: Free educational programs led by park rangers covering geology, ecology, history, and Native American culture. Programs vary seasonally with campfire talks and guided walks.

activities.name: Logan Pass Visitor Center & Trail Exploration
activities.description: Stop at the park's main visitor center at the Continental Divide with interactive exhibits and films, then explore surrounding short trails including Hidden Lake Overlook. Essential orientation for first-time visitors.

activities.name: Stargazing & Night Sky Photography
activities.description: Experience pristine dark skies perfect for Milky Way photography and stargazing. The park's remote location makes it an International Dark Sky Park with exceptional viewing.

activities.name: Whitefish Mountain Resort Activities
activities.description: Year-round mountain resort offering mountain biking, chairlift rides, scenic gondola experiences, and hiking with panoramic views. Located near the park with multiple summer activity options.

spots.name: Grinnell Lake
spots.description: Iconic turquoise glacial lake surrounded by peaks and waterfalls, offering breathtaking reflections and color contrasts perfect for landscape photography.
spots.bestTime: Early morning for calm water and soft light

spots.name: Avalanche Lake
spots.description: Stunning turquoise alpine lake with cascading waterfalls, lush vegetation, and dramatic peaks creating a postcard-perfect composition.
spots.bestTime: Midday when waterfalls are most dramatic

spots.name: Logan Pass Continental Divide
spots.description: Dramatic high-altitude mountain pass with views across the park, perfect for wide-angle landscape and silhouette photography.
spots.bestTime: Sunrise or sunset for golden light and clouds

spots.name: Many Glacier Valley
spots.description: Expansive valley with turquoise Swiftcurrent Lake, historic hotel, and jagged peaks reflected in still water.
spots.bestTime: Early morning before crowds and for reflections

spots.name: Going-to-the-Sun Road Pullouts
spots.description: Multiple scenic pullouts along the iconic highway offering sweeping vistas of valleys, lakes, and mountains throughout the drive.
spots.bestTime: Golden hour at either end of day

spots.name: Hidden Lake Overlook
spots.description: Accessible via short hike from Logan Pass, offering dramatic views of a mountain lake with potential for mountain goat and wildlife photography.
spots.bestTime: Morning light for clear details and wildlife activity

spots.name: Lake McDonald Shore
spots.description: The park's largest lake surrounded by forested shores and distant peaks, ideal for long-exposure and reflective water photography.
spots.bestTime: Sunrise for calm conditions and warm light

spots.name: Jackson Glacier Overlook
spots.description: Designated viewpoint with clear sightlines to the glacier against surrounding peaks, accessible from Going-to-the-Sun Road.
spots.bestTime: Midday for clear visibility of glacier details

spots.name: Two Medicine Lake
spots.description: Pristine alpine lake with Mount Jackson backdrop and Eagle Plume Falls, offering excellent composition opportunities with multiple foreground elements.
spots.bestTime: Early morning for reflections and mist

spots.name: St. Mary Lake at Sunrise
spots.description: Large glacial lake with dramatic peaks reflected in water at dawn, creating golden light across the eastern shore.
spots.bestTime: Pre-dawn to catch first light hitting peaks

lensRecommendations: Wide-angle 14-24mm for expansive landscape vistas and valley compositions
Standard 35-70mm for versatile hiking and mid-range mountain photography
Telephoto 70-200mm for wildlife, distant peaks, and compressed alpine compositions
Macro lens for wildflower and detail work in meadows and forest floors
photography.goldenHourNotes: Golden hour light is exceptional at Glacier with extended hours during summer months. The high elevation and east-west valleys create perfect lighting angles at both sunrise and sunset. Plan for 30+ minutes of usable light before full sunrise and after sunset, allowing extended photography sessions during optimal color conditions.

weather.seasonality: Summer (June-September) offers warm weather, full trail access, and all lodging open with extended daylight for photography. Winter (December-March) brings heavy snowfall, closed high passes, and limited accessibility, though offers stunning snowy landscapes and solitude.
weather.summary: Glacier experiences distinct seasons with long, cold winters and short, mild summers. Spring and fall offer transition weather with unpredictable conditions, while summer provides optimal hiking and photography opportunities with temperatures between 15-21°C. High elevation areas receive significant precipitation year-round, especially during summer months.

hotels.name: Many Glacier Hotel
hotels.description: Historic 1915 Swiss chalet-style hotel with 215 rooms, situated directly on Swiftcurrent Lake with views of Mount Jackson and easy access to valley trails.

hotels.name: Lake McDonald Lodge
hotels.description: Historic 1913 lodge featuring 100 rooms on the shores of the park's largest lake with rustic charm and convenient access to west side trails.

hotels.name: St. Mary Lodge & Resort
hotels.description: Comfortable 72-room hotel just outside the park's east entrance with modern amenities, restaurant, and convenient access to Going-to-the-Sun Road.
